name: Jean-Pierre Dubois
bio:
Jean-Pierre Dubois has been turning bare metal into rolling works of art for over two decades. Hailing from Montreal, his passion for motorsport ignited at a young age, fueled by the roar of Formula 1 cars at the Circuit Gilles Villeneuve. He honed his skills at a local custom car shop before transitioning to the high-stakes world of racing, where precision and speed are paramount.

Jean-Pierre's meticulous approach to paint application and detailing is legendary within RFK Racing. He believes that a flawless finish isn't just about aesthetics; it's about contributing to the overall performance and brand image of the team. He is known for his innovative use of modern paint technologies and his unwavering commitment to perfection. While he pushes his team hard, it's driven by a desire to produce the best results possible, every single time.

His understanding of aerodynamics and how the paint finish can affect airflow sets him apart. He’s always looking for that extra edge, that marginal gain that can make all the difference on the track. Jean-Pierre is not just a painter; he's a crucial component of the RFK Racing machine.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Jean-Pierre is of average height with a stocky build, reflecting years of dedicated work.

quirks: Always has a meticulously clean workspace, bordering on obsessive.
Insists on listening to classical music while working, claiming it enhances his focus.
Has a habit of tapping his foot to the beat of the music, even when it's a slow movement.
